name: Flow Dissolve
description: Both clips ride one current full of eddies: a sharp front sweeps across it and is wound into curls by every eddy it crosses, the first clip carried downstream ahead of it while the second pours in behind, until the second clip settles sharp. Drive `progress` from 0 to 1.

inputs.name: second
inputs.description: Incoming clip (same size as the first)

params.name: direction
params.description: Direction of the current (x right, y up)

params.name: travel
params.description: How far the current carries the clips (1: half the frame's short side)

params.name: swirl
params.description: Strength of the eddies compared with the drift (0: a straight front and drift)

params.name: seed
params.description: Random seed: another value gives other eddies
